# PROVENANCE (Codex did not write this: it is the fixture's header)
# REAL review of commit 302fb02 of this same skill, done by Codex
# gpt-5.6-sol on 2026-09-21 with the orchestrator's improved brief. It brought 10
# findings where round 1 of lane T1, on the SAME commit, had brought 2.
# The original text came in PROSE (## HIGH / ## MEDIUM / ## LOW + a numbered
# list). Here it is ADAPTED to the `FINDING:` block format that the new prompt
# asks for (PROMPT_VERSION 2), keeping the TITLES, the SEVERITIES and the
# places VERBATIM. It serves as the positive control of the findings parser: if
# the parser stops pulling out these 10 titles, the ledger row lies.

FINDING: A state sent to any agent is considered communicated to the orchestrator
SEVERITY: HIGH
WHERE: scripts/orchestrator-control.js:5016
TRIGGER: a `SendMessage` with text `STOPPED · ...` addressed to another lane, not to the owner
EVIDENCE: `readLaneInItsTurn` checks the text of `input.message`, but never `input.to`; it sets `reading.status=true` and clears `silent_streak`
REMEDY: accept the state only when `input.to` corresponds to the orchestrator

FINDING: The vocabulary of sent states is wrong: `BLOCKED` is missing and `READY` is extra
SEVERITY: HIGH
WHERE: scripts/orchestrator-control.js:4887
TRIGGER: a correctly sent `BLOCKED`, or a `READY ·` ack at the start of the turn
EVIDENCE: `RE_STATE_MESSAGE` is `STOPPED|DONE|READY` while the screen recognises `STOPPED|DONE|BLOCKED`
REMEDY: use `STOPPED|DONE|BLOCKED` for the closing state and leave `READY` only as accreditation

FINDING: The screen regex matches prose and can disable future real alerts
SEVERITY: HIGH
WHERE: scripts/orchestrator-control.js:4882
TRIGGER: a quote, an example or a code block containing `STOPPED ·` or `BLOCKED`
EVIDENCE: the false positive leaves `silent_streak.warned=true` and silences a later genuine `STOPPED`
REMEDY: recognise explicit anchored declarations and do not consume the streak with an ambiguous match

FINDING: The abstention on a truncated tail prevents re-arming a streak even when the positive state is visible
SEVERITY: HIGH
WHERE: scripts/orchestrator-control.js:4987
TRIGGER: a huge turn whose start falls outside the 4 MiB but which does end by sending `DONE`
EVIDENCE: the function returns `null` before looking for state sends, so the streak is not cleared
REMEDY: return a partial reading and let the positive evidence break the streak

FINDING: `validateBrief` accepts negative mentions or examples as valid instructions
SEVERITY: HIGH
WHERE: scripts/orchestrator-control.js:7181
TRIGGER: a brief that says "Do not use SendMessage; write `STOPPED ·` only on your screen"
EVIDENCE: it only looks for the substrings `STOPPED ·` and `SendMessage` in the whole section
REMEDY: require the affirmative instruction, not the mere presence of the substring

FINDING: The accreditation by `from-name` does not accredit identity
SEVERITY: MEDIUM
WHERE: scripts/orchestrator-control.js:4997
TRIGGER: two terminals with the same name, or a quote that contains a similar label
EVIDENCE: a `from-name` is extracted with a regex from any user text and compared with a mutable name
REMEDY: validate the stable identifier of `from`, or remove this path

FINDING: The `READY` ack accredits even if it is sent to the wrong recipient or fails
SEVERITY: MEDIUM
WHERE: scripts/orchestrator-control.js:5003
TRIGGER: a `READY ·` sent to another agent, or whose `tool_result` was a failure
EVIDENCE: `readyAck` is set on the first pass without checking `input.to` or crossing the `tool_use.id`
REMEDY: reuse the delivery and recipient validation before accepting the ack

FINDING: The new 4 MiB read does not strictly respect the total 9 s budget
SEVERITY: MEDIUM
WHERE: scripts/orchestrator-control.js:4944
TRIGGER: reaching the gate with milliseconds left and a transcript close to 4 MiB
EVIDENCE: it makes up to four additional passes without checking `END`
REMEDY: require margin before starting the read and check the deadline in every pass

FINDING: The re-arm test for a new brief does not exercise the real path
SEVERITY: LOW
WHERE: tests/test-orchestrator-control.mjs:7969
TRIGGER: any change that breaks the real path without touching the text `s.silent_streak = null`
EVIDENCE: it clears `silent_streak` by hand in the JSON and then only looks for that line in the source
REMEDY: dispatch two `BRIEF-T9-*` paths through the real event and check that the second re-arms

FINDING: The mutant of `isBoldParagraph` for `validate --brief` is vacuous
SEVERITY: LOW
WHERE: tests/test-orchestrator-control.mjs:8137
TRIGGER: a brief that besides the bold paragraph carries a real item
EVIDENCE: both the healthy and the mutated version return status 0
REMEDY: a brief whose only content is the `**...**` paragraph

ANGLES APPLIED: false positives and false negatives
COULD NOT CHECK: the full suite (the read-only sandbox failed to create its temporary directory with EPERM)
VERDICT: 10 REMAIN
